summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for float level switch no, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The float-operated NO form connects a discrete electrical action to a defined liquid-level mechanism. The drawing must identify the vessel or location and the direction of level movement that actuates the contact.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Match the electrical reference state to the documented float orientation.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Float level sensing is different from a continuous analog level transmitter.
